message: No detected input validation: The code contains no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; images and labels are loaded and used without any structural or type validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data from local filesystem paths using glob and os; no remote source fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication is present.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data at any point in the preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds and compiles models from scratch (Sequential, Functional API) without loading any pretrained weights or serialized models, so there is no integrity verification implemented.

No detected label distribution validation: Although plot_dist() visualizes label distributions, there is no programmatic check that validates class balance, enforces expected label sets, or flags anomalous samples before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly analysis are present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/TensorFlow training without any differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD attack code are present anywhere in the pipeline slice.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed via sklearn's train_test_split, there is no held-out test set isolation from training data verification, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (predictions/probabilities) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a CNN image classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
